goals.text: List all notes in the order they were created.
Create a note with text and receive it with an id.

terms.name: note
terms.definition: A piece of text held by the notes service, with an id assigned when it is created.

terms.name: note text
terms.definition: The text content of a note. It must not be empty.

terms.name: note id
terms.definition: A whole number that identifies a note. The first note created has id 1, and each later note has the next number.

rules.response: shall return all notes in creation order

rules.trigger: a client creates a note with text
rules.response: shall return the created note with its id and text
shall assign each new note the next note id, starting at 1

rules.trigger: a client creates a note with empty text
rules.response: shall reject the request with status 400 and store no note

examples:
Feature: Notes

  Rule: R-1

    @R-1 @E-1
    Scenario: Listing with no notes returns an empty list
      Given there are no notes
      When a client lists the notes
      Then the response status is 200
      And the response is an empty list

    @R-1 @E-2
    Scenario: Listing returns notes in creation order
      Given there are no notes
      And a client has created a note with text "buy milk"
      And a client has created a note with text "walk dog"
      When a client lists the notes
      Then the response status is 200
      And the response lists the note with id 1 and text "buy milk" first
      And the response lists a second note

  Rule: R-2

    @R-2 @E-3
    Scenario: A created note is returned with its id and text
      Given there are no notes
      When a client creates a note with text "buy milk"
      Then the response status is 201
      And the response contains a note with id 1 and text "buy milk"

  Rule: R-3

    @R-3 @E-4
    Scenario: The second note gets the id 2
      Given a client has created a note with text "buy milk"
      When a client creates a note with text "walk dog"
      Then the response status is 201
      And the response contains a note with id 2 and text "walk dog"

  Rule: R-4

    @R-4 @E-5
    Scenario: A note with empty text is rejected and not stored
      Given there are no notes
      When a client creates a note with text ""
      Then the response status is 400
      And a client lists the notes and gets an empty list
contract:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Notes service
  version: 1.0.0
  description: An in-memory notes service.
paths:
  /notes:
    get:
      operationId: listNotes
      summary: List notes
      description: "Returns all notes in creation order."
      x-rules: [R-1]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: All notes in creation order.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/Note"
    post:
      operationId: createNote
      summary: Create a note
      description: "Creates a note with the given text and returns it with its id."
      x-rules: [R-2, R-3, R-4]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/NewNote"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: The created note.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Note"
        "400":
          description: "The text is empty."
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
components:
  schemas:
    NewNote:
      type: object
      required: [text]
      properties:
        text:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
    Note:
      type: object
      required: [id, text]
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        text:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
    Error:
      type: object
      required: [message]
      properties:
        message:
          type: string

questions.text: Is text made only of spaces treated as empty, so that creating such a note is rejected?
